summary: Diageo plc filed a Form 6-K disclosing an internal board committee reshuffle rather than a special situation. Effective 6 November 2026, non-executive director Melissa Bethell replaces Susan Kilsby as Chair of the Remuneration Committee; Kilsby remains on the Board as Senior Independent Director and continues as a member of the Audit, Nomination and Remuneration Committees. The disclosure follows UKLR 6.4.6R, the UK Listing Rules equivalent of a US Item 5.02 director/officer change report. No financial terms, advisors or regulatory clocks apply. Watch only for governance signal, not for arbitrage.
